findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_price_quote, check_pdf_margins, compose_letter, upload_document · Private data: check_pdf_margins, compose_letter, upload_document, fix_document_margins, create_upload_link, create_letter · Public sink: get_price_quote, check_pdf_margins, compose_letter, upload_document, fix_document_margins, create_upload_link, send_letter.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_price_quote, check_pdf_margins, compose_letter, upload_document · Private data: check_pdf_margins, compose_letter, upload_document, fix_document_margins, create_upload_link, create_letter · Public sink: get_price_quote, check_pdf_margins, compose_letter, upload_document, fix_document_margins, create_upload_link, send_letter

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
